selection_process: Selection for Agniveervayu Intake 01/2027 involves document verification followed by multiple test stages, all typically conducted over the rally days. || Verification of Eligibility:Original/DigiLocker-verified educational certificates and other applicable documents (domicile, COAFP, NCC, discharge certificate, etc.) are scrutinised prior to the Physical Fitness Test. || Physical Fitness Test (PFT):PFT-I: 1.6 Km run — male candidates within 7 minutes, female candidates within 8 minutes.PFT-II (after 10 minutes recuperation): Male candidates — 10 push-ups (1 min), 10 sit-ups (1 min), 20 squats (1 min), with rest breaks between exercises. Female candidates — 10 sit-ups (1 min 30 sec), 15 squats (1 min), with rest breaks between exercises. || PFT-I: 1.6 Km run — male candidates within 7 minutes, female candidates within 8 minutes. || PFT-II (after 10 minutes recuperation): Male candidates — 10 push-ups (1 min), 10 sit-ups (1 min), 20 squats (1 min), with rest breaks between exercises. Female candidates — 10 sit-ups (1 min 30 sec), 15 squats (1 min), with rest breaks between exercises. || Adaptability Test-I (AT-I):Objective written test assessing suitability for employment in varied geographic, weather, and operational conditions. || Adaptability Test-II (AT-II):Assesses adaptability to Indian Air Force environment and military way of life; conducted the same or a subsequent day. || Medical Examination:Conducted in September 2026 at Jorhat (for 11 ASC) and Sri Vijaya Puram (for 8 ASC), including baseline investigations such as blood haemogram, urine RE/ME, blood sugar, serum cholesterol, RFT, LFT, chest radiograph, ECG, and (for female candidates) ultrasonography of the lower abdomen and pelvis. || Appeal Medical Board (AMB):Candidates declared medically unfit may appeal by depositing ₹40 via e-MRO/MRO within three working days of the medical examination. || Provisional Select List and Enrolment:The state-wise Provisional Select List (PSL) is prepared based on performance and state-wise cut-offs and vacancies; inclusion in the PSL does not guarantee enrolment. The final Enrolment List is published after the PSL.
